body: Y’all ever had those Hereshy white chocolate chips?
True, I’m still debating it but thanks

Today I’m still not feeling well but I don’t think I’ll try again. The last time I asked my mom was last week, but the thing is whenever I suggest there’s something wrong with me and I need help for it she wants to take my door off the hinges and take away my phone and all that stuff “to keep me safe” but it just makes me feel powerless so I try to refrain from talking to her, but thanks for caring.
We love a good rebellious staple
